package ports

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
)

type RevisionProvider interface {
	GetPublishedRevisionEnvelope(context.Context, string) (domain.RevisionEnvelope, error)
}

type LearningActionPort interface {
	Reserve(context.Context, ReserveLearningAction) (LearningActionBinding, error)
	Get(context.Context, string, string) (LearningActionBinding, error)
	Open(context.Context, OpenLearningAction) (LearningActionBinding, error)
	CancelProvisioning(context.Context, CancelLearningAction) (LearningActionBinding, error)
}

type LearningRouteProvider interface {
	ResolveRoute(context.Context, ResolveLearningRoute) (domain.LearningRouteReceipt, error)
	ReconcileReadiness(context.Context, ReconcileLearningReadiness) (domain.LearningReadinessReceipt, error)
	Materialize(context.Context, MaterializeLearningStep) (LearningMaterialReceipt, error)
}

type WorkspacePort interface {
	CreateOrResumeWorkspace(context.Context, CreateWorkspace) (domain.WorkspaceBinding, error)
	FreezeSnapshot(context.Context, FreezeSnapshot) (domain.SnapshotRef, error)
	ReadPinnedSnapshot(context.Context, domain.SnapshotRef) (WorkspaceSnapshot, error)
	LockWrites(context.Context, LockWorkspaceWrites) (WorkspaceWriteLock, error)
	UnlockWrites(context.Context, UnlockWorkspaceWrites) (WorkspaceWriteLock, error)
	RestoreWorkspace(context.Context, RestoreWorkspace) (domain.WorkspaceBinding, error)
}

type ValidationPort interface {
	ValidateOfficialSubmission(context.Context, OfficialValidationRequest) (domain.ValidationResult, error)
}

type EvidencePort interface {
	ApplyPassedEvidence(context.Context, PassedEvidence) (EvidenceReceipt, error)
}

type Repository interface {
	CreateOrLoadStart(context.Context, domain.TaskInstance) (domain.TaskInstance, bool, error)
	GetInstance(context.Context, string, string) (domain.TaskInstance, error)
	GetInstanceByID(context.Context, string) (domain.TaskInstance, error)
	ListInstances(context.Context, string, string, int, domain.TaskInstanceStatus) ([]domain.TaskInstance, string, error)
	SaveInstance(context.Context, domain.TaskInstance) (domain.TaskInstance, error)
	CreateOrLoadIntent(context.Context, domain.SubmitIntent) (domain.SubmitIntent, bool, error)
	SaveIntent(context.Context, domain.SubmitIntent) error
	GetIntent(context.Context, string, string) (domain.SubmitIntent, error)
	CommitIntent(context.Context, domain.SubmitIntent, domain.Submission, domain.ValidationRun) error
	GetSubmission(context.Context, string, string) (domain.Submission, error)
	GetValidationContextByRunID(context.Context, string) (domain.TaskInstance, domain.Submission, error)
	ListSubmissions(context.Context, string, string, int) ([]domain.Submission, string, error)
	SetRunRunning(context.Context, string, time.Time) error
	CompleteValidation(context.Context, domain.Submission, domain.ValidationRun, domain.TaskInstance) error
	CreateValidationRetry(context.Context, domain.Submission, domain.ValidationRun) error
	SaveReview(context.Context, domain.Submission, domain.TaskInstance, string, string) error
	CompleteInstanceAndEnqueueEvidence(context.Context, domain.TaskInstance, domain.Submission, json.RawMessage) error
	CreateOrLoadCommandReceipt(context.Context, string, string, string, string) (bool, error)
	PendingValidationRuns(context.Context, int) ([]PendingValidation, error)
	PendingEvidence(context.Context, int) ([]OutboxMessage, error)
	MarkEvidenceDelivered(context.Context, string, time.Time) error
	MarkEvidenceFailed(context.Context, string, time.Time, string) error
	// GetAssistance checks the current owner and returns ErrIdempotency for a usage bound to different identities.
	GetAssistance(context.Context, string, string, string) (AssistanceReceipt, string, error)
	RecordAssistance(context.Context, domain.TaskInstance, AssistanceReceipt, string) (domain.TaskInstance, AssistanceReceipt, bool, error)
}

type ReserveLearningAction struct {
	StudentID             string
	TaskInstanceID        string
	TaskRevisionID        string
	TaskRevisionDigest    string
	LearningActionID      string
	SurfaceClassification string
	LearningTargets       []domain.Target
	LearningPathItemID    string
	RequirementID         string
	LearningPathID        string
	OccurredAt            time.Time
}

type LearningActionBinding struct {
	LearningActionID      string
	StudentID             string
	TaskInstanceID        string
	TaskRevisionID        string
	TaskRevisionDigest    string
	SurfaceClassification string
	LearningTargets       []domain.Target
	LifecycleStatus       string
	LearningPathItemID    string
	RequirementID         string
	LearningPathID        string
	PathVersion           int64
	PathPosition          int
}

type OpenLearningAction struct{ StudentID, TaskInstanceID, LearningActionID string }
type CancelLearningAction struct{ StudentID, TaskInstanceID, LearningActionID, Reason string }

type ResolveLearningRoute struct{ Request json.RawMessage }
type ReconcileLearningReadiness struct {
	IdempotencyKey string
	TaskInstanceID string
	StudentID      string
	TaskRevisionID string
	RevisionDigest string
	RouteID        string
	RouteDigest    string
	StepID         string
}
type MaterializeLearningStep struct {
	TaskInstanceID string
	StepID         string
	RouteID        string
	RouteDigest    string
	MaterialKey    string
	GenerationKey  string
	Target         domain.Target
}
type LearningMaterialReceipt struct {
	Schema      string        `json:"schema"`
	MaterialKey string        `json:"material_key"`
	Target      domain.Target `json:"target"`
	CourseID    string        `json:"course_id"`
	LessonID    string        `json:"lesson_id"`
	Reused      bool          `json:"reused"`
}

type CreateWorkspace struct {
	RequestID      string                 `json:"request_id"`
	StudentID      string                 `json:"student_id"`
	TaskInstanceID string                 `json:"task_instance_id"`
	TaskRevisionID string                 `json:"task_revision_id"`
	RevisionDigest string                 `json:"revision_digest"`
	RuntimeProfile json.RawMessage        `json:"runtime_profile"`
	StarterFiles   []domain.WorkspaceFile `json:"starter_files"`
}

type FreezeSnapshot struct{ SandboxID, SubmissionID, TaskInstanceID string }
type WorkspaceSnapshot struct {
	Ref   domain.SnapshotRef
	Files []domain.WorkspaceFile
}
type LockWorkspaceWrites struct{ SandboxID, RequestID, Mode, SubmissionID string }
type UnlockWorkspaceWrites struct{ SandboxID, LockID, RequestID string }
type RestoreWorkspace struct {
	SandboxID, TaskInstanceID string
	Ref                       domain.SnapshotRef
}
type WorkspaceWriteLock struct {
	LockID     string
	FenceEpoch int64
	Permanent  bool
}

type OfficialValidationRequest struct {
	TaskInstanceID           string             `json:"task_instance_id"`
	SubmissionID             string             `json:"submission_id"`
	ValidationRunID          string             `json:"validation_run_id"`
	RevisionDigest           string             `json:"revision_digest"`
	ValidationContractDigest string             `json:"validation_contract_digest"`
	Snapshot                 domain.SnapshotRef `json:"snapshot"`
	Scope                    string             `json:"scope"`
	MilestoneID              string             `json:"milestone_id,omitempty"`
	ValidationSpecification  json.RawMessage    `json:"validation_specification"`
}

type PassedEvidence struct {
	EvidenceID              string           `json:"evidence_id"`
	LearningActionID        string           `json:"learning_action_id"`
	LearningPathItemID      string           `json:"learning_path_item_id,omitempty"`
	RequirementID           string           `json:"requirement_id,omitempty"`
	StudentID               string           `json:"student_id"`
	TaskInstanceID          string           `json:"task_instance_id"`
	TaskRevisionID          string           `json:"task_revision_id"`
	TaskRevisionDigest      string           `json:"task_revision_digest"`
	WorkspaceDigest         string           `json:"workspace_digest"`
	SubmissionID            string           `json:"submission_id"`
	Targets                 []domain.Target  `json:"targets,omitempty"`
	Steps                   []string         `json:"steps,omitempty"`
	HintsUsed               int              `json:"hints_used"`
	MaxHintLevel            *int             `json:"max_hint_level,omitempty"`
	TeacherAssistanceUsed   bool             `json:"teacher_assistance_used"`
	AssistancePolicyVersion string           `json:"assistance_policy_version"`
	Evidence                []TargetEvidence `json:"evidence"`
	OccurredAt              time.Time        `json:"occurred_at"`
}

type TargetEvidence struct {
	Target       domain.Target `json:"target"`
	Correctness  float64       `json:"correctness"`
	Independence float64       `json:"independence"`
	Confidence   float64       `json:"confidence"`
	StepIDs      []string      `json:"step_ids"`
}

type EvidenceReceipt struct {
	Schema           string `json:"schema"`
	EvidenceID       string `json:"evidence_id"`
	LearningActionID string `json:"learning_action_id"`
	Accepted         bool   `json:"accepted"`
	PolicyVersion    string `json:"policy_version"`
}

type PendingValidation struct {
	TaskInstanceID string
	StudentID      string
	SubmissionID   string
	RunID          string
}

// These internal codes describe technical delivery failures, never learner outcomes.
const (
	EvidenceFailurePayloadInvalid      = "EVIDENCE_PAYLOAD_INVALID"
	EvidenceFailureIdentityMismatch    = "EVIDENCE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH"
	EvidenceFailureProviderUnavailable = "EVIDENCE_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE"
	EvidenceFailureReceiptMismatch     = "EVIDENCE_RECEIPT_MISMATCH"
	EvidenceFailureDeliveryMarker      = "EVIDENCE_DELIVERY_MARKER"
)

type OutboxMessage struct {
	StudentID    string // Trusted persisted TaskInstance owner, never derived from payload.
	ID           string
	SubmissionID string
	Payload      json.RawMessage
	Attempts     int
}

type AssistanceReceipt struct {
	Schema         string    `json:"schema"`
	UsageID        string    `json:"usage_id"`
	StudentID      string    `json:"student_id"`
	TaskInstanceID string    `json:"task_instance_id"`
	StepID         string    `json:"step_id"`
	Kind           string    `json:"kind"`
	HintLevel      int       `json:"hint_level,omitempty"`
	PolicyVersion  string    `json:"policy_version"`
	OccurredAt     time.Time `json:"occurred_at"`
}

// SameCommand compares only frozen caller input. Policy and occurrence time are
// server-owned facts from the first committed receipt, never retry identity.
func (receipt AssistanceReceipt) SameCommand(other AssistanceReceipt) bool {
	return receipt.Schema == other.Schema && receipt.UsageID == other.UsageID &&
		receipt.StudentID == other.StudentID && receipt.TaskInstanceID == other.TaskInstanceID &&
		receipt.StepID == other.StepID && receipt.Kind == other.Kind && receipt.HintLevel == other.HintLevel
}
